title: What's New in Sustainability: Value Chain in Projects (2025 release wave 2)

features.name: Value Chain Automation in Projects
features.description: Extension of value chain automation to project journals and purchase invoices with project numbers. When posting purchase invoices for projects, the system generates two lines: a purchase line and a negative adjustment entry that enters into sustainability value entries.
caveats: Only works with carbon equivalent, not other gases

features.name: Sustainability Fast Tab on Items
features.description: Items now have a sustainability fast tab where users can set a standard account number and default CO2 emissions number, with the system calculating total CO2.

features.name: Sustainability Fast Tab on Resources
features.description: Resources now have a sustainability fast tab allowing users to add accounts and set default CO2 emission numbers for resource-based calculations.

features.name: Project Statistics with Emissions Data
features.description: Project statistics now display emissions calculations and workflow-related sustainability data, allowing users to see the impact of project activities on carbon footprint.

features.name: Scope Three Coverage via Value Chain
features.description: The value chain automation enables end-to-end scope three coverage, tracking not just supply chain emissions but also project-related emissions for comprehensive environmental impact reporting.

features.name: Procurement Setup for Value Chain Tracking
features.description: Users can enable value chain tracking for sustainability via a single field in the Sustainability Setup procurement fast tab. Once enabled, emissions are automatically calculated and tracked.

quotes.text: We enabled this value chain automation for carbon footprint embedded. So this is something what we already introduced in previous wave.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that value chain automation for carbon footprint was introduced in a previous release, establishing the foundation for the project extension.

quotes.text: So what are business values with this functionality will really cover end to end scope three coverage.
quotes.why_it_matters: States the primary business value of the feature - comprehensive scope three emissions coverage beyond supply chain.

quotes.text: It is important to remember it doesn't work with all gases only with the carbon equivalent.
quotes.why_it_matters: Sets a clear technical limitation that the system only uses carbon equivalent calculations, not other individual gases.

quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core posting mechanism for emissions in projects, including the dual-line entry approach.
